Audited claim rows P3-24 (historical floating-point Hill gate at 30609de2c), P3-25 (historical regex screen versus three non-regex matchers behind AntigenMatcher), P3-29 (exact threshold and panel input refusals), and P3-30 (Examiner 24-problem companion).
